reviews.text: Lovely place in the countryside, staff so nice who clearly love dogs.  Such a great service for a working Mom of a fur baby!

I can’t recommend Vet-Sit highly enough. It gives me such peace of mind knowing Ruby is in such loving, caring hands. She’s always so happy when I drop her off and comes home full of life and contentment. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my precious girl – it means the world to me. 🐾❤️ …

Vet - sit offer an excellent service to both doggie clients and owners! Murph is a rescue and is new to me and to Vet-Sit who stuck with him following a shaky start. Despite his charm, he likes things his own way  but has made huge strides in the month and we’re getting there.
The Vet -Sit Team are professional, welcoming,  honest in their feedback and hugely encouraging. Murph didn’t want to leave this morning which is such a good sign!
Thank you to all - Orla Kehily
We are more than happy with the care our Rough Collie gets at Vet Sit . The staff obviously love their charges and our boy Finn is often reluctant to come home
Happy Dog Happy owner  Great Staff Thank You

I was very worried to leave Cleo in for her first stay in a cattery, and the Vetsit staff were so good about sending me daily updates. All the pictures of her making friends with the staff and playing with different toys every day really helped me feel confident that she was being spoiled and enjoying her holidays. Thank you to everyone who took such good care of her, can’t recommend the team highly enough.

I can’t recommend @vetsitspa @vet.sit highly enough. They’ve groomed my dogs for years, and I’ve also trusted them completely with both daycare and overnight stays.

The team are absolutely fantastic — genuinely caring, professional and wonderful with the dogs. My girls love going there, which says everything! They always come home looking gorgeous after their grooms, but most importantly, they come home happy, relaxed and clearly very well cared for.

It gives me such peace of mind knowing they’re somewhere they enjoy being and with people I completely trust. An excellent service all round and a very special team. Highly, highly recommended! 🐾❤️

Absolutely amazing. We’ve been using VetSit for about a year now and have complete peace of mind knowing that Sully is going to be well looked after while we’re in work/away on holiday. He was nervous at first and the staff in VetSit have taken such good care of him! Recently, we have started using the grooming service in VetSit and Chrissy (the amazing groomer) has showed us the ideal Labrodoodle groom! Value for money aside, VetSit daycare and grooming service is absolutely amazing and we would highly highly recommend!
Ned comes back from here feeling and smelling gorgeous. The team do a brilliant job and he's never happier than when he's up at Vetsit. Would highly recommend 🐕‍🦺

I recently brought my 4 months old puppy for the very first time to VetSit; before this I spoke to staff to get more information regarding what to bring for him when leaving him at the day care, their facilities, etc and I found them professional, and very informative details provided. He spent 2 days in day care and the night between the 2 days and he was very well looked after. I knew they also look after grooming so I asked them to clip his nails and this was done without a problem. The staff noticed a condition he had and contacted me immediately regarding this and the recommended treatment; once I consented to this, they treated him straight away. He was happy and not a care in the world when I picked him up, which was great to see. I will definitely bring him back to VetSit and although he was only there for once so far, I already know he is well cared for by the team; obviously knowing that there is always a Vet present, I know I can trust that if he needs anything while his stay, he will be immediately checked and treated. I think it's great to have so many services in one place, doggies needs are met straight away if required.
I really appreciated the communication with the team, texts or phone calls, they are hands on, which is great.

Thank you all for your care and see you soon!

Our boy Marley loves visiting for his groom, he’s pampered and so well looked after sometimes he wants to stay longer. The care and attention they give your pet is second to none. Very very highly recommended

Sammy is a very nervous border collie who has found boarding stressful in the past. But it was a different story at Vetsit where he relaxed in the lovely space, met other doggy guests and looked extremely chilled when we went to pick him up after his visit. We’ll certainly be sending him on his holidays there again. And to add after his second stay, it was like we hadn’t left him. He was very relaxed and no sign of the tension or anxiety we have experienced at other boarding facilities
Vetsit is a wonderful place for our dogs. The staff are loving and welcoming and I couldn’t recommend them highly enough.

I have been using vet sit for a while now for my two boys and I could not recommend enough. I am very verrry picky about where I leave my dogs and I don’t need to worry when they are in Vet Sit as they are always well looked after and very happy - to the point that when they are being fussy and missing me they are hand fed 😂. One of my boys had spinal surgery in June and was 6 weeks into his recovery last week when he went to vet sit and Katie could not have reassured me more that he would be well looked after and he was! Very very grateful.
Thank you Katie and team.. Kygo and Bear will see you next week for another stay!
As always, both my dogs had a wonderful time at Vetsit and they love going back. It was great to see photos of them on instagram during the day and the staff (as always) are just fantastic

What a fabulous place. My Dog Cookie just loves all the open space and having loads of other dogs to play with. Excellent customer service and fantastic staff. I highly recommend Vet Sit
Suzanne
Have been using Vetsit since 2024. Our pug is always so well minded and looked after as if he’s one of their own. They are always so accommodating to us and such a pleasure to deal with.

Five stars all the way for the team at VetSit . They did an amazing job of caring for our dog after he had emergency back surgery . Their expertise and kindness ensured that he continues to make a good recovery .

Can’t recommend Katie & team enough - Bruno is my baby and they minded him so well while I was away; daily updates and minded him like their own! Highly recommend if your dog is your literal child they go above and beyond and have you feeling at ease while you enjoy your holiday 🤍
Loved it - superb people and my dogs had a ball . Looked after them so well in the hot weather

I got an overnight stay for our little Miniature Jack Russell earlier this week
He seemed to really enjoy his time
Katie was very reassuring and positive about the little man.
I enjoyed looking at his photos on Instagram which showed him in excellent spirits
He is also safely getting sociable with other dogs
I was very impressed by everything that I saw.
Chrissy even shortened his nails when he stayed
Tayto is staying for 10 days soon and I have no worries
I know he will be very well taken care of
Hats off to VetSit and all their team
Just to add Tayto has been with VetSit for 10 days
We collected him yesterday
He got great care and love from the team
He has grown up!!!
The Instagram posts were lovely
We are delighted with the service
Can’t speak highly enough
The little man has a 5 star service

Thank you so much for taking such good care of little Pixie. As a 12-year old princess she needs extra-special love and attention…which she got in abundance with you and your wonderful team. Loved getting the email updates and following her on Instagram playing with her little pals. Don’t know what we’d do without you! Xxx

I'm going to focus this review on the cattery, but we've been also happily been using their dog boarding services as well. We had never used a cattery before, and had in the past opted for home visits. However, with this trip being over a month and with us being so far away - we just didn't want to take any risks. The care that our cat got over the course of the month was extraordinary! Their communications about her well being and the daily pictures made it so much easier for us to see she settled in nicely and was happy and healthy. To add to the positivity, our cat has an unusual attachment to a small stuffy she's had her whole life (that is quite bedraggled). They made sure that her little stuffy stayed with her and was returned with her in perfect shape. Thank you so much for taking such good care of our pets. We are so grateful for everything!
My cat Tibbs had a lovely little stay at Vetsit recently. He came back really happy and seemed to have a great time exploring 😄 …

We left our cat Maisie in the great care of Vetsit where she was looked after so well and i got pictures daily to show how happy she was. Maisie got play time and plenty of cuddles so I am so pleased with her care. I would highly recommend VetSit and Maisie will be back again for her holidays!!!!. Thank you!!!

Katie and her team are amazing. Our two Golden Retrievers Indie and Bailey spent the last four days in Vetsit. The care they received was outstanding in every way, Indie is a rescue and extremely nervous and scared due to her very traumatic start in life. The staff managed her perfectly and we can now go away again with an easy mind. I would highly recommend Vetsit to anyone looking for the best care for their animals.

Coco and Rolo loved their first stay with Vetsit. Vetsit were recommended to us by a friend .The staff we met there are so lovely and caring you know they love their job. Our boys are  not used to mixing with other dogs, so they were kept with the little  dogs, with a view to them getting used to mixing more and more with all dogs. We have already booked them in for our next holiday.

Very professional and friendly service.
Every confidence in leaving Misty in their care. Came home a very happy dog!

Our two dogs had the best experience  with vetsit for 9 days boarding ,I think they still miss all the other dogs and attention!!they loved it ,we were thrilled and looking forward to our next hols knowing that the dogs are having fun too!!

Chrissy at VetSit does the best job of grooming my 3 furbabes! My girls get bows every now and then and it just melts my heart. Toes and private bits are always neat and trimmed. Absolutely take the best care and pay attention to what each breed needs and cuts them to their breed standards which I truly appreciate. Most importantly, they love her too!! Highly recommend Chrissy for her services. 5/5
Our dog Cloud adores going to VetSit - it's a home away from home. The staff are so kind and caring and are just wonderful. I'd highly recommend VetSit Doggy Daycare!

Milo stayed with Vetsit for 7 nights end of April. He had the best time the love and care all the team give to their doggie friends is excellent. He came back so relaxed  and we couldn't be happier with the level of care he was given during his stay. We also got daily updates and it was great to see Milo mixing and having fun with all his furry friends. Would highly recommend Vetsit the outdoor space is fantastic and the attention that they give is next to none, one very happy customer, and Milo is excited for his next visit.

We've been taking our sheepadoodle puppy Milo to Chrissy over the last few months for his groom and pamper and to say it's a brilliant place is an understatement.
Milo gets completely pampered,makes new friends both two and four legged and comes back with the most beautiful cut and waggiest tail. He is so happy going in and coming out which is so important. It's testament to how well he is treated by Chrissy and the team. Would highly recommend Vet sit dog grooming. The girls are amazing. We'll keep going back. Sandra Roe

We've been getting our mini schnauzer groomed in Vetsit for 4 years now and I cannot recommend it highly enough! Chrissy is an incredible groomer and always delivers exactly the style you're looking for! The premises is fantastic with a beautiful area for the dogs to play while they wait for their pampering session! 10/10 from us!

Chrissy is absolutely incredible with our dog Bobby when he gets his grooming done. She’s so caring, patient, and always does an amazing job. Bobby (cavachon) comes home looking fantastic and so happy every time. We wouldn’t trust anyone else. Highly recommend!

VetSit has been our trusted boarding facility for our dog, Goyo, for the past four years, and we honestly could not recommend them more.

Goyo stays there several times a year when we go on holiday, sometimes for long periods of a month or more, and we always feel completely calm and reassured knowing he is in such good hands. The team takes extremely good care of him, and they upload several photos every day of him playing and enjoying time with the other dogs, which gives us so much peace of mind.

Goyo is always happy to return, which says everything. We also use their dog daycare from time to time, and the extended hours are fantastic, especially when we need to drop him off before going to the office and pick him up afterwards.

All the staff are incredible, kind, and genuinely loving towards Goyo. Katie, the owner, is always very nice and welcoming, and Goyo absolutely loves her. VetSit has become a place we truly trust, and we highly recommend them to anyone looking for boarding or daycare for their dog.

VetSit is absolutely phenomenal! The boarding and daycare facilities are absolutely heavenly, so much so I was jealous of my puppy getting to stay there 😂 I was to say a very special thank you to all the staff who have been beyond helpful and accommodating with arrangements when I was in under pressure for an event. They made everything so easy and seriously took all the stress off the situation! On top of all this, they spoil the doggos so much that I am pretty certain my boy Otis was disappointed to have to come home 😂😂 will never bring him anywhere else ❤️

Shadow is so happy at the daycare! He’s a big Labrador puppy, so having other dogs his size to play with and large open spaces to run around in is really important - Vetsit are perfect for this. The team are so great and really understand all dog needs and behaviours. Taxi service is such a bonus to have. Shadow was also was groomed one of the days and it was excellent. They really know what they are doing! ❤️
Finn had a great happy stay

Maggie our British Bulldog spent a couple of nights with Vetsit recently, she ran in delighted to say hello, It was very reassuring to know she would have fun and be very well looked after by Katie and her wonderful staff at vet sit. She is looking forward to her next holiday there in May.

Our cockapoo Pep absolutely loves her sleepovers with her friends in Vetsit & is exhausted when we get her home from all the fun she's had! Vetsit are the best team & it's great peace of mind going away knowing that your dog is being very well taken care of & very happy there. We have & will continue to recommend Vetsit Thank you Vetsit team. So lovely & reassuring to get the pictures of her having the time of her life while we are away
Simply the best😊

Our dog Cara has alot of health issues, so leaving her when we go away has always been a worry for us..
VetSit were absolutely fantastic with her, we’re so happy to have found somewhere we completely trust, and it’s such a comfort knowing she’ll be well cared for and loved while we’re away.

I'm so glad we found VetSit! Our little dog loves visiting his friends there and he's become a more confident and friendly companion.  I feel such peace of mind knowing he's having a good time and is well taken care of.
Great place for our puppy. I know he is in safe hands and he loves it!
Very helpful and attentive staff. So happy we found them!
Luna loves going here, everyone so caring and she had a great time running around outside.

As always, Max comes home happy and exhausted.  Telling us of how much fun he had with the humans he loves and all the new friends he makes each visit.  I could not recommend VetSit more enthusiastically.  It's clear that both the animals and humans all love each other.  Just look at the smiles on the faces of every dog on their Insta account! lol

We started bringing our 4 month old Cavapoo to VetSit to help socialize her and I cannot recommend a better place for her, the facilities are amazing and the staff truly care about the animals! Highly recommend!
Highly recommend VetSit. As always,  the greatest care and service for our puppy Zola from all staff who have been fantastic. Thank you and see you again soon 👌 …

VetSit always a life saver, whenever we need send my dog to spend some energy thats the place and they go the extra mile if they can.
Much appreciated for everything.
Love vetsit! They pay great care of our child Rusty, and he comes back tired and snoozing.

Bertie had a fantastic stay and Vetsit. The facilities are excellent and the personalised care Bertie received was of a really high quality. Will definitely be returning and recommending to others. Great grooming staff too, Bertie came out all pampered and handsome.

My little 5 month old Cavapoo attended Vetsit.
I wanted her to mix with other puppies and play some training games. I was anxious leaving her. I need not have worried. I collected a happy little puppy. Staff are very caring and lovely. I would highly recommend Vetsit 👍🏼 …

Archie and Molly have so much fun at VetSit that they are straining to get out the car door to go in the gate. They are exhausted when they come home. I am really delighted to have someone give them all the love and attention when we are not around. They have gone to daycare and stayed overnight and we can relax knowing they are safe, loved and having fun!

We’ve been bringing our two boys, Duckie and Avery, to VetSit in Kilternan for both boarding and doggie daycare, and couldn’t be happier with the care they receive. What sets VetSit apart is that the owner and many of the staff are vets, vet nurses, and vet techs—this gives us tremendous peace of mind, especially given our dogs’ special needs.

Duckie has a very sensitive stomach and is prone to pancreatitis, which makes us nervous about boarding anywhere. Every time we pick him up from VetSit, he comes home happy and healthy, which speaks volumes about how carefully they monitor his diet and overall wellbeing. Avery has high anxiety, and we can always tell when he’s had a good experience—he’s noticeably happy and as relaxed as possible for him. The staff clearly know how to handle anxious dogs with patience and care.

We also regularly bring them for doggie daycare, which has been wonderful for their social interaction and exercise needs. It’s a great way for them to burn off energy and spend time with other dogs in a supervised, safe environment.

Beyond boarding and daycare, VetSit offers a full range of services including walks, baths, full grooming, nail clips, and basically everything else you could need for your pup. They also offer pickup within a certain radius, which is incredibly convenient.
We find pricing to be very reasonable given the quality of care, the staff’s veterinary expertise, and the comprehensive services they provide. For dogs with medical conditions or behavioral challenges, having trained veterinary professionals caring for them is worth every cent.

Our boys have settled in beautifully at VetSit, and we highly recommend them to anyone looking for trustworthy, professional care for their dogs!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Hi Moselle,

I’m sorry to hear that your experience with VetSit did not meet your expectations.

As a residential-based daycare and boarding facility, we occasionally determine that our setting may not be the right fit for every dog. These decisions are made very carefully and with both welfare and community considerations in mind.

We wish you and Sybil all the very best.
Our dog Tilly absolutely loves this place, and the staff. The team are always great, and very caring of our dog.

We drop our dog off for daycare here a few days a week and sometimes for kennels overnight. The team at vetsit are so friendly and our dog loves going there, she literally runs up to the gate to get in. They take such good care her and you can tell they all really care about dogs. Couldn't recommend them enough!

Like every other review here, I cannot speak highly enough of this place. Such kind staff and always incredibly professional. Scooby absolutely loves it here and it's the perfect place for him to burn off his high energy. We've tried multiple day cares in and outside Dublin and this is by far the best place we've come across. Hard to think how it could actually be better! Highly recommend.

Can't recommend VetSit enough. Our rescue lurcher, Ozzy, howls with excitement in the car as we reach the gate. He adores his time there and we can head off knowing he is happy. Getting the videos and pics of him running around is also a huge comfort. My husband described it as "Disneyland for dogs" and I couldn't put it better myself!
The staff at Vetsit are extremely welcoming and diligent. Our dog is always excited when we bring her for her day visit. Great service all round and the staff are very friendly and helpful !

Absolutely brilliant experience with VetSit, we could not recommend them highly enough. Our dog Doughball stayed with them while we were on holidays and the love, care and attention she got was genuinely amazing. From the first update we knew she was safe, happy and being treated like one of their own.

She had loads of gorgeous green space to run around in, plenty of new dog friends to play with. The highlight for her was definitely the bath in the doggy day spa.

It is such a relief to go away knowing your dog is not just being minded, but truly cared for. We will definitely book VetSit again, Doughball is already planning her next holiday! 🐾💛

I recently started using the services of Vetsit as daycare for my springer spaniel, Bugsy. The staff are all caring dog lovers and having a qualified vet on staff is a great comfort. The facilities are amazing and the setting idyllic- think of ‘the shire’ from Lord of the Rings 😁 Check out the daily postings for Vetsit on Instagram and you can see how happy and well cared for all of the dogs look. Bugsy comes home thoroughly exhausted and looking very pleased with himself after a full day of play with his doggy mates. I have also used their doggy grooming services. They did a great job and rates, as with all the rates at Vetsit, were very reasonable. Vetsit also board dogs for longer stays and I will have no hesitation on boarding Bugsy with them the next time I go on holiday. It’ll be a holiday for him too! Friendly, professional staff and thoroughly Dog Centric Service!! Your precious pet will be more than safe in their hands.

This is the very best dog boarding facility in Dublin.
Larry loves every minute of his stay always and returns home happier than Larry 🤣
All the staff, in particular Amy, are fantastic and take such pride in their kennels.
Thank you guys so much 🐾
Unbelievable care taken of our puppy golden Remy. Everyone at Vetsit is kind, caring and goes out of their way to make your pet feel at home from home. Couldn’t recommend them more highly.

An absolutely wonderful dog hotel and day care. The countryside farm setting is just beautiful so spacious, calm, and a dream environment for dogs. What truly sets this place apart, though, is the personalised care and genuine kindness shown to every dog. It’s clear they are true dog lovers who treat each guest as an individual, not just a booking. I had complete peace of mind knowing my dog was cared for with such warmth, attention, and understanding. Highly recommended.

This place was recommended to us by friend, whose dog stayed with Vetsit for couple times before.
Our dog was with Vetsit for 10 days while we were on Holidays. He really enjoyed the stay, didn't want to go home. They were out in large field everyday, running and playing together.  Our dog is only 1 and 6 months, very active and playful. We could never provide so much social interaction and activity for him at  home.
The guys are brilliant, definitely gonna use again and already  recommended to several dog owners in the local dog park,

Hey...My name is Archie. I'm a 2 year old cocker spaniel. I have bundles of energy and can play all day long. My human brings me to Vetsit. As I approach the gate, I get so excited I bark in the car and my tail goes mad! I see all my friends there and we have fun all day long.
From Archies Human: Archie has a ball at Vetsit....he's delighted going in and comes home tired and fulfilled. He comes home with a happy glint in his eyes and I know he's had fun and lots if interaction when at vetsit. Will continue to use!!

We leave our little man Ted in Versit when we are away and sometimes in the day care. He absolutely loves it. Everyone is so kind and lovely, Ted comes mes home happy and loves going back for his holidays. I think that says it all. The dogs have a beautiful space to play and plenty of freedom to run around. Would very much recommend Versit, just a lovely place with kind people and happy pets.

The care and advice Vet-Sit provided for Max this week and the sore toe that he went in with was exceptional, including taking him to our vet and keeping us fully informed. With special thanks to nurse Clare for taking such good care of him.
Teresa and Mike Clarke

More happy holiday photos from Nico at Vetsit, looking gorgeous after her grooming, before & after photos below.
This is a little paradise for dogs, they are so well treated and the welcome Nico gets each time from the team when she arrives is so lovely to see.
Thanks to all the team, you’re all simply the best!!
I brought my collie in for grooming, and she was nervous, but they were lovely with her and when I collected her a few hours later, she looked gorgeous and a few years younger! Highly recommend
It's a fantastic place, and the team is exceptionally well-prepared and organized. They also provide you with feedback and tips.
Another  happy weekend for our nervous puppy at Vetsit... he loves it.  Could not recommend highly enough!!!

Gatsby is a regular and takes all his holidays at Vetsit - in fact, there is nowhere else in Dublin that I would trust leaving him for any period of time. They are so kind, on top of everything, take such great care of him and love him to pieces. In fact, I worry that if he could speak, he would tell us that he is moving in with the Vetsit team!!

Gatsby loves them and so do we.

VetSit staff really care for your animals and my lurcher had the time of her life there for 10 days (it was unclear if she actually wanted to come home or not). They provide great updates so you don’t have to worry while you are away. Well worth the money to have your pet in such good hands!

What an amazing facility! Everyone is so kind and it feels like a home away from home. Our dog loves the fields and trails and playing with the other dogs. We really appreciate getting photo updates and sweet comments. Great peace of mind knowing our dog is having his own holiday while we enjoy ours worry free. Enjoyed an extended stay recently and our dog had a blast! We also booked a groom before we came back and it was fantastic! Best grooming he’s had anywhere!
Superb care at vetsit for our puppy-

A really great service. The staff here take amazing personalized care of the dogs. They have a huge secure area for running around and playing. The photos and email
Updates are really reassuring and a nice touch. Would recommend the service to friends and family.

The VetSit team was incredibly kind and took the best care of our old friend Gutti for a few days. Everyone was very welcoming and made sure Gutti was comfortable and happy. ❤️
To the whole team - thank you so much! He was very happy and we are very grateful for all the love you shared with Gutti.
Dido & Lily just had three nights  and four days of fun and games with their pals at Vetsit.  They came home so happy and chilled out.   It really is a wonderful service.  The dogs just love it 🐾🐾 …

Teddy our big Goldendoodle is just back from his holiday with Vetsit in Kilternan. We wanted a caring home from home, with space to roam and that’s exactly what we got. Fantastic setup and experience, from initial contact, to daily photos updates, to collecting a tired and happy dog. We’ll be back!
This is a five star holiday for dogs Molly did not want to come home the last time !! She loves it so much the dogs staff are amazing

An amazing doggy daycare and kennel for dogs. We’ve used them so many times and they look after our Bobby so well. He’s a very nervous & anxious dog and they are so good and caring with him. Thank you! ⭐️

I was worried my lab Asha would have separation anxiety staying away from home. However when I went to pick her up she didn’t want to leave Vet Sit!. She had so much fun, and apparently lots of cuddles and attention, which is what she ‘commands’ at home. I am so at ease now leaving Asha in the care of the staff of Vet Sit that I won’t hesitate to book her in many more times in the future.
I use Vetsit for both daycare and boarding. My dog loves Katie and all the team. Fantastic location with loads of space and safe and secure. I have no hesitation in recommending!
Great service and our dog loves her day and overnight stays. Highly recommend them :)
This place is Dog Heaven - They are able to run free during the day, sleep on couches at night, it's luxury dog care. Cooper was there for a week and came back a better dog - Highly recommended!
Such a great service, Highly recommend!

Our dog LOVES going to VetSit.  To the point that he doesn't want to come home when we get back.  The facilities are amazing with lots of indoor and outdoor play spaces.

The team are great at keeping in touch, with updates and social posts too so you can see exactly what they've been up to!
Can’t recommend vetsit enough. The staff are so lovely and my dog Bobbi was so well taken care of. I loved all the daily photos and updates ❤️
My 2 Springer Spaniels love it here, there's great space for them to run and play and socialise and the team take excellent care of them. It's such a relief to know they're being so well looked after

Thank you to the VetSit team for their wonderful care of our rescue dog Bella. Whilst she loves people, she is shy/apprehensive of other dogs, preferring a quieter environment  - she has her spot on the sofa in the greenhouse to relax. Over the past year the VetSit team have been very supportive, and provided helpful advice including moving her daycare day to a less busy day for a few months so she could get used to the routine and other dogs. We’ve recently returned from a long holiday, she boarded with VetSit who provided superb care to Bella and her humans with regular photos and updates.

Highly recommended!

Miss Bella and Janet

If you’re looking for high-quality boarding for your dog, I highly recommend VetSit. I was a bit nervous leaving our 7-year-old dog, as she had never stayed in boarding before, but the team at VetSit was absolutely lovely and genuinely cared for the dogs. I really appreciated the open communication and how smoothly they handled our booking. We also loved receiving daily updates while we were on holiday. Our dog had a fantastic time and was in great spirits when we picked her up. Thank you so much to the wonderful staff!
We've used VetSit twice now and have loved them! Our dogs are well looked after, well groomed, and always enjoy their stay.

Absolutely thrilled with Riley’s 11day stay at VetSit and hope to book him in again shortly. What can I say, the place met all our expectations, freedom to run around and mix with all other dogs, big and small as he’s a very sociable and active “almost” three year old. The daily pics were great to receive while on holidays and a wonderful idea. I love the whole concept of VetSit and the staff have such a wonderful way with the doggies. They get a 10 out of 10 from me.

Can't speak highly enough about Katie, Amy, Rimantus, Anna and the wider VetSit Crew.

Reached out again in early 2025 to get our doggie Juno back into Daycare after taking a break.

The whole team welcomed her back in and she now has a weekly visit and has just done an overnight stay. The highlight of her week with games, doggie company and lots of exercise! Literally wrecked at each collection!

All the staff have great respect and empathy for the dogs (and owners!).

Whether you are a First Timer or a Returning client - would highly recommend giving it a go.

Worth every cent.

Well done to the Vet Sit Team.
Hi Michael, thanks for your feedback. I’d love to hear what we could improve about our service, if you’d like to reach out over email, we are always keen to make any and all improvements.

Our 11 year old poodle mix Dog recently had a trail overnight stay with the wonderful staff in vetsit. Pike suffers with allergies and the care and attention he received during his stay was five star.
